_doc: Operator standing grants (RC-360). A grant is ACTIVE only when this file is COMMITTED at HEAD — operator_law_guard reads it via `git show HEAD:governance/operator_grants.json`, never the worktree, so an agent cannot self-grant: the enabling commit is operator-lane and IS the ratification. Revoke by committing granted:false.
